Sources have confirmed 
that President Biden will host George Floyd's family at the White House on Tuesday, May 25th which marks the first anniversary of Floyd's death. We continue to press for the George Floyd Justice in Policing Act! #GeorgeFloyd #ICantBreathe #BlackLivesMatter

On this date May 25, 2020, one year ago today George Floyd was murdered. Since then, more Americans have died while encountering the police. #GeorgeFloyd should be alive today. We continue to remain non-violent in the face of injustices towards justice Amen. #BlackLivesMatter

We remember #EMT Breonna Taylor today on what would've been her 28th Birthday🙏🏾 Her life was stolen away from her unjustly by the action of @LMPD on March 13, 2020. We continue seeking justice for #Brewayy, and others in the era of #BlackLivesMatter
 #SayHerName #BreonnaTaylor

BREAKING: Earlier today, Judge Peter Cahill announces that former police officer Derek Chauvin will spend 22.5 years in prison for the murder of George Floyd. We are #unsatisfied with Chauvin's sentence. Next, Federal charges against Chauvin's is still pending.
#BlackLivesMatter

HM🔟 wishes every American a
Happy 4th of July 🇺🇸! While we celebrate America's Independence, we must live our lives as scripture indicates in 1st Peter Chapter 2 verses 16-17 Amen. Furthermore, the non-violent fight continues. #SundayVibes #HappyFourth   #BlackLivesMatter
